text.description_html:
Brass Accents A04-K5800, 9" Solid Brass Americana Door Knocker

The Americana Door Knocker is so named not only because it is a replica of the door knocker found on the Blair House in Washington, D.C. where guests of the White House stay but also because it is proudly made in the U.S.A. out of solid bronze with a Satin Nickel finish. This front door knocker is perfect for traditional, colonial style homes. The 9 inch height means that it will make a bold statement on any door. It has a satin nickel finish and comes packaged with all the necessary mounting hardware.

Specifications of the 9" Americana Front Door Knocker:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Finish: Satin Nickel
  • Height: 9"
  • Width: 4-1/8"
  • Rosette Diameter: 2-3/8"
  • Mounting Centers: 5-1/4"
  • Projection: 2-7/16"

Limited quantities available, Only 1 Left.
